details: Bitcoin has seen significant upward momentum, pushing towards the $79,000 level, fueled by renewed institutional interest and an overall improvement in market sentiment. Analysts are closely watching whether Bitcoin can successfully break past the key psychological resistance of $80,000. This rally follows strong inflows into spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs), contributing to a generally bullish outlook.
title: Bitcoin Approaches $79K Amid Renewed Institutional Interest

details: XRP experienced a notable surge of nearly 19% after President Donald Trump's recent meeting with crypto industry executives and regulators at the White House. Discussions at the summit focused on potential new crypto regulations, with signals that a framework could be established even if the stalled Clarity Act doesn't pass. This optimism also positively impacted other major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, which saw double-digit gains.
title: XRP Jumps 18% Following White House Crypto Regulation Talks

details: The peer-to-peer crypto marketplace NoOnes has announced its shutdown, urging its 2.5 million users to withdraw their funds immediately. The closure stems from sanctions that led to the loss of essential partners and caused blockchain monitoring providers to flag NoOnes' wallets as high-risk, making continued operation unsustainable.
title: Crypto App NoOnes Shuts Down Due to Sanctions, Affecting 2.5M Users

details: Artificial intelligence agents are increasingly utilizing stablecoins for various payments, particularly for small-value transactions. Key industry players such as Circle, Visa, and Mastercard are actively working to adapt their existing payment networks to facilitate these agent-driven purchases. USDC is estimated to account for a significant majority of these AI-powered payments.
title: AI Agents Poised to Drive Stablecoin Micropayments Growth

details: A research prototype named Hazync has demonstrated rapid, millisecond-level validation for initial Bitcoin blocks using zero-knowledge proofs (ZK-proofs). While a complete "genesis-to-tip" proof for the entire Bitcoin blockchain is still in progress and projected to require substantial GPU computational power, this technological advancement aims to enhance the efficiency and reusability of Bitcoin validation.
title: Bitcoin Validation Advances with New ZK-Proof Prototype

details: El Salvador is said to be maintaining its policy of purchasing one Bitcoin daily. This consistent accumulation strategy has reportedly increased the nation's total Bitcoin holdings to 7,751.37 BTC, with an estimated value of approximately $599 million.
title: El Salvador Reportedly Continues Daily Bitcoin Purchases
